payload.core_mechanism_summary: Construct a 2x3 matrix with a large power of two (2^17) to trick the DP into picking a path that yields AND 0 instead of the optimal k.
payload.rationale: The code uses a well-known bit manipulation trick: set x = 2^17, then matrix entries (x+k, x, 0; k, x+k, k). The DP greedily chooses the high bit over k, leading to AND 0, while the optimal path gives k. This exploits AND non-optimal substructure via binary representation.
